content_blocks.markdown:
**Arguments**
```json
{
  "function": "() => {
  const inputs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input, kat-input')).map(el => ({
    tag: el.tagName,
    name: el.name || el.getAttribute('name'),
    id: el.id || el.getAttribute('id'),
    value: el.value || el.getAttribute('value'),
    placeholder: el.placeholder || el.getAttribute('placeholder'),
    label: el.getAttribute('aria-label') || (el.labels && el.labels[0] ? el.labels[0].innerText : null)
  }));
  const bodyText = document.body.innerText;
  return {
    inputs: inputs.filter(i => i.value !== 'all'),
    bodySnippet: bodyText.slice(0, 3000)
  };
}",
  "pageId": 12
}
```

content_blocks.markdown:
**Arguments**
```json
{
  "function": "() => {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const cb = document.querySelector('tbody tr input[type="checkbox"]');
      if (cb) {
        cb.click();
        setTimeout(() => {
          const actionBars = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*="action"], [class*="bulk"], [class*="selected"], [role="toolbar"]')).map(el => el.innerText).filter(Boolean);
          const allButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b => b.innerText).filter(Boolean);
          resolve({
            checked: cb.checked,
            actionBars: actionBars.slice(0, 10),
            allButtons: allButtons.filter(t => t.includes('移除') || t.includes('操作') || t.includes('已选') || t.includes('批量') || t.includes('弃置') || t.includes('Action') || t.includes('Removal'))
          });
        }, 800);
      } else {
        resolve({ error: 'No checkbox found' });
      }
    }, 2000);
  });
}",
  "pageId": 1,
  "waitForStableDom": true
}
```

**Arguments**

{
  "function": "() => {
  const skusToFind = [
    '4A071',
    '4A MEETING-41-W*4',
    '4A Meeting 42x4',
    '4A 6031x4',
    '4A 004',
    '4A 303-Holder+Flag',
    '4A 301x24x2',
    '4A 30315'
  ];
  const text = document.body.innerText;
  const results = {};
  for (const sku of skusToFind) {
    const idx = text.indexOf(sku);
    if (idx !== -1) {
      results[sku] = text.slice(Math.max(0, idx - 100), Math.min(text.length, idx + 400));
    } else {
      results[sku] = 'NOT_FOUND_ON_PAGE_1';
    }
  }
  return results;
}",
  "pageId": 1,
  "waitForStableDom": false
}
